title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-11-02-personal-prep
content:
Meeting: Weekly sync — Serving Runtime / Infra / Console
Date: 2026-11-02 10:00-11:00 PT
Location: #eng-serving-runtime slack huddle + zoom (link in calendar)
Owner (prep): Evan Chen
Attendees (pre-req): Maya, Diego, Aisha, Liam, Priya, SRE on-call (TBD)

Purpose: quick cross-team alignment on infra incidents, rollout status for console changes, perf regression checks, and outstanding action items. Keep to 45m discussion + 15m deep-dive slot.

Agenda:
1) Quick wins / blockers (5m)
   - Status updates from each subarea (1 slide or 1-2 bullets)
   - Any high-priority customer impact? (call out customer IDs)

2) Incidents / on-call handoff (10m)
   - Post-mortem draft for 2026-10-28 KV-cache OOM (owner: Diego) — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/987
   - Current on-call escalations and mitigation status

3) Rollouts & deployments (10m)
   - Console feature flags: rollout plan for new per-model telemetry (A/B 10% -> 50%) (owner: Maya)
   - Dedicated autoscaler changes (RWI-2312) — verify canary metrics (owner: Liam)

4) Performance & cost metrics (10m)
   - Recent perf spike on 2048-seq runs (observed 12% p99 increase) — initial theory: kernel selection regression after latest compiler bump
   - Quick profiling ask: determine whether quantized path used for r12 models (owner: Aisha)

5) Console / UX ops (5m)
   - Error tracing workflow improvements: add prefilled JIRA template for runtime traces
   - Observability retention toggle request (customer: AcmeCorp) — scope/impact discussion

6) Action items review & new assignments (5m)
   - Review open items from last week and statuses
   - Assign new owners and due dates

Deep dive (optional, last 15m):
- Diego to demo KV-cache instrumentation and recent mitigation patch (if time)

Notes / Prep items (for me, Evan):
- Pull latest p99/p95 by model from observability dashboard before meeting (dashboard: /dashboards/serving/perf-by-model)
- Sync with SRE on current node utilization and preemptible vs reserved split
- Confirm Maya's telemetry rollout doc link and canary success criteria

Action items (tracking table - informal):
- DI-101: Diego -> Finish post-mortem draft for KV-cache OOM, include memory profile graphs. Due: 2026-11-04. (status: in_progress)
- MG-77: Maya -> Finalize telemetry rollout plan + add canary metric thresholds. Due: 2026-11-06. (status: todo)
- AI-12: Aisha -> Verify quantized execution used for r12 models on night runs; provide profiler output. Due: 2026-11-05. (status: todo)
- LN-9: Liam -> Watch canary for autoscaler change RWI-2312; report any scaling anomalies. Due: 2026-11-09. (status: todo)
- EV-55: Evan -> Compile weekly notes and update Confluence page after meeting. Due: 2026-11-03. (status: todo)

Follow-ups from last meeting (quick statuses):
- Diego: KV-cache mitigation landed in staging (PR merged), needs load test validation — loading schedule: 2026-11-03
- Maya: Console telemetry backend schema approved; front-end PRs in review (2 outstanding)
- Aisha: Completed quantization benchmarking for r10 family; r12 still pending (blocked by profiling infra)

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Approve 50% rollout threshold for telemetry feature by eod 2026-11-04? (need sign-off: Maya + infra lead)
- Do we enable longer traces for canary groups by default? (cost vs debug win)

Prep checklist (what to bring to meeting):
- Diego: post-mortem draft + staging load test plan
- Maya: telemetry rollout doc + list of affected customers
- Aisha: profiler sample snippet showing quantized vs non-quantized path
- Liam: canary metrics screenshot for autoscaler change

Misc scratch notes (to capture in meeting):
- If perf regression is tied to compiler bump, schedule rollback window to restore p99 targets for high-SLO customers (AcmeCorp, BetaHealth)
- Consider temporary per-customer routing to older runtime for top 5 enterprise customers if regression persists

End of prep notes. Will convert action items to Confluence + JIRA tasks after meeting.

-- Evan
summary: Personal prep notes and agenda draft for the 2026-11-02 weekly serving-runtime/infra/console sync; includes agenda, prep checklist, and tracked action items with owners and due dates.
